title: Reach help before choosing a project
when: Projectless question, installation recovery or unfamiliar operation
need: CLI help and public product docs remain reachable before a project is selected. Installed .yoke/docs belongs to the project layer and cannot be assumed in an unrelated folder.
surface: Root/operation help → public docs; planned global guide points to the same route
gap: Make this explicit in yoke-global and global orientation. A bare README.md in the current directory is not Yoke product help.
surface_notes: https://upyoke.com/docs: Accessible without a local project document tree; online access is distinct from offline CLI help.
